text: ヤドンさんって　すごい　ポケモン　くわしいんだ！

structure.jp: すごい　ポケモン　くわしいんだ！
structure.en: knows an awful lot about Pokémon!

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って after a word is a casual way to bring it up as the thing you are talking about. ヤドンさんって = 'Mr. Slowpoke, you know'.

patterns.name: 〜に詳しい
patterns.span: ポケモン　くわしい
patterns.explanation: くわしい normally takes に for the thing someone knows well; in casual speech the に is dropped here. ポケモン　くわしい = 'knows a lot about Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ at the end gives the sentence an explaining tone, like 'you see'. くわしいんだ = 'he knows a lot, you see'.
